pucRule.citation: 16 Tex. Admin. Code § 25.483 — Disconnection of Service
pucRule.title: Texas retail electric disconnection rules
pucRule.summary: Governs disconnection notice, deferred payment plans, and weather-related disconnection prohibitions for retail electric providers.

deferredPaymentArrangement.note: Deferred payment plans are required in defined circumstances; terms are shorter than most states.

moratoria.label: Extreme heat disconnection prohibition
moratoria.appliesTo: Residential customers when the National Weather Service issues a heat advisory for the county

moratoria.label: Freeze disconnection prohibition
moratoria.appliesTo: Residential customers when the forecast low for the county is at or below freezing

authorityRule.title: Meridian Energy voice-agent delegated authority — Texas
authorityRule.text: Voice agents may agree residual payment arrangements at or above $165 per month in Texas. Amounts below the floor require credit-officer approval at authority level L2 or above.
